Email.ResetPassword.Heading: Reset your password
Email.ResetPassword.Intro: We received a request to reset the password of your {appName} account. Choose a new password with the button below.
Email.ResetPassword.Footer: If you did not ask to reset your password, ignore this email and your password will not change.

Email.Deletion.Title: Your {appName} account will be deleted
Email.Deletion.Heading: Your account is scheduled for deletion
Email.Deletion.Intro: We received your request to delete your {appName} account. Your data is hidden and you cannot sign in. On {date} (UTC) your account and data will be deleted permanently. Changed your mind? Cancel before then to restore everything.
Email.Deletion.Footer: This link works once. If you did not ask to delete your account, cancel now and change your password.
